checks.command: Push-Location cezar; npm run typecheck -w @open-mercato/cezar-contract; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Contract typecheck failed.' }; Pop-Location

Push-Location cezar; $paths = @(ConvertFrom-Json $env:FACTORY_CHANGED_PATHS | Where-Object { $_ -match '^cezar/packages/api-client/' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '^cezar/packages/api-client/', '' }); $tests = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' }); $sources = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' -and $_ -notmatch '\.(test|spec)\.' }); npm run typecheck -w @open-mercato/cezar-api-client; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'API client typecheck failed.' }; if ($tests.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar-api-client -- vitest run $tests } elseif ($sources.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar-api-client -- vitest related --run $sources }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'API client focused tests failed.' }; Pop-Location

Push-Location cezar; $paths = @(ConvertFrom-Json $env:FACTORY_CHANGED_PATHS | Where-Object { $_ -match '^cezar/packages/cezar/' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '^cezar/packages/cezar/', '' }); $tests = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' }); $sources = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' -and $_ -notmatch '\.(test|spec)\.' }); npm run typecheck -w @open-mercato/cezar; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cezar server typecheck failed.' }; if ($tests.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar -- vitest run $tests } elseif ($sources.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar -- vitest related --run $sources }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cezar server focused tests failed.' }; Pop-Location

Push-Location cezar; $paths = @(ConvertFrom-Json $env:FACTORY_CHANGED_PATHS | Where-Object { $_ -match '^cezar/packages/web/' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '^cezar/packages/web/', '' }); $tests = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' }); $sources = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -match '\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$' -and $_ -notmatch '\.(test|spec)\.' }); npm run typecheck -w @open-mercato/cezar-web; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cezar web typecheck failed.' }; if ($tests.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar-web -- vitest run $tests } elseif ($sources.Count -gt 0) { npm exec --workspace @open-mercato/cezar-web -- vitest related --run $sources }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cezar web focused tests failed.' }; Pop-Location

$pythonRunner = if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python3.12 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'python3.12' } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'py' } else { $null }; if (-not $pythonRunner) { throw 'Python 3 is required for focused Factory release tests.' }; $pythonArgs = if ($pythonRunner -eq 'py') { @('-3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'tests.test_factory_local_scheduler', 'tests.test_factory_activation', 'tests.test_factory_release_controller') } else { @('-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'tests.test_factory_local_scheduler', 'tests.test_factory_activation', 'tests.test_factory_release_controller') }; & $pythonRunner @pythonArgs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Factory release unit tests failed.' }
